name: Aligned double JPEG (A-DJPG)
corpus: synthetic photo-like scenes generated from fixed seeds (forensic.validation.run.scene)

detection.task: Is the JPEG aligned double compressed (decoded and re-saved on the same grid)?
detection.positives: 120 images saved at a random first quality Q1 in [50, Q2-5], then at Q2
detection.negatives: 120 images saved once at Q2 in {75, 85, 90, 95}

localisation.task: Which 8x8 blocks were pasted in (single compressed) into a double-compressed image?
localisation.cases: 60 splices: background saved at Q1 in [50, 80) then the composite at Q2 in {85, 90, 95}; pasted rectangle 20-50 % of each side, grid-aligned

known_failure_modes: Not detectable when the first quality was higher than the second (see tpr_when_q1_above_q2).
Not detectable after resizing, rotation or off-grid cropping between saves (use the non-aligned grid analysis).
Flat or saturated regions carry no information and can look single-compressed in authentic images.
Synthetic corpus: real-camera figures must be measured with --pristine or public datasets.
